key.name: delay
key.summary: Idle seconds before the screensaver starts (0 = never); set in Settings > Power > Screensaver

key.name: file
key.summary: File name in ~/Pictures/screensaver to show; empty = slideshow of all files (falls back to a slideshow if the file is missing)

key.name: slide-seconds
key.summary: Seconds per picture in slideshow mode

key.name: lock-on-dismiss
key.summary: Lock the session when the screensaver is dismissed
